warRiskPremium.note: Ships face ~4,000× higher insurance costs (The National). 'Ceasefire Won't Lower War-Risk Insurance Rates' (houseofsaud). Updated 2026-06-14
warRiskPremium.note_zh: 船只保费飙升约4000倍。'停火不会降低战争险费率'。更新于 2026-06-14

straitThroughput.note: Iran formally closed strait entirely Jun 11. US claims 7M b/d, Chevron CEO rebuts. US-Iran deal nearing (Trump: 'agreement to be signed soon'). Updated 2026-06-14
straitThroughput.note_zh: 伊朗6月11日正式宣布全面关闭海峡。美方声称日通航700万桶，雪佛龙CEO反驳。美伊和约接近达成。更新于 2026-06-14

irgcStatementFreq.note: Iran formally closed strait Jun 11. Strikes on Bandar Abbas/Qeshm. US-Iran deal talks ongoing. Escalation ladder: formal closure >> negotiation. Updated 2026-06-14
irgcStatementFreq.note_zh: 伊朗6月11日正式关闭海峡。美军打击阿巴斯港/格什姆岛。美伊谈判进行中。升级阶梯：正式关闭>>谈判。更新于 2026-06-14

fleetPosition.note: Awaiting orders, no active escort missions. US strikes on Bandar Abbas/Qeshm confirmed. Updated 2026-06-14
fleetPosition.note_zh: 等待命令，无护航行动。美军打击阿巴斯港/格什姆岛已确认。更新于 2026-06-14

saudiUaeStance.value_zh: 向美施压，探索替代方案

saudiUaeStance.note: Saudi jet fuel supply to Europe higher. OPEC+ 4th quota hike. Saudi energy minister visited Russia. MBS lifted Lebanon ban. 'Hormuz Shock Hits Gulf Economies, Saudi Takes Center Stage'. Updated 2026-06-14
saudiUaeStance.note_zh: 沙特对欧航空燃油供应增加。OPEC+第四次增产。沙特能源部长访俄。MBS解除黎巴嫩禁令。'霍尔木兹冲击海湾经济，沙特站上C位'。更新于 2026-06-14
